# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen or eighteen at the start of college, and around nineteen to twenty during her college years at Redmond.  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 c3 P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v3 c20 P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 c4 P33](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0033)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Redmond College and temporary schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c6 P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 c31 P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cordelia  <sub>[v1 c3 P15](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0015), [v1 c3 P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019), [v1 c17 P33](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0033)</sub>; Carrots  <sub>[v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a tall girl with big gray eyes, a small pointed chin, and a freckled complexion. She is known for her long red braids, which she once disastrously dyed green in an attempt to change their color. Though described as skinny and homely in her younger years, her looks grow more refined as she matures, featuring loosened ringlets and starry eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c28 P24](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0024), [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c11 P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038), [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035)_

## Personality

Anne is intensely imaginative, romantic, and passionate, often losing herself in vivid dreamlands and dramatic scenarios. She possesses a high-spirited temper and a strong tenacity for holding grudges when her pride is wounded. Extremely affectionate and dedicated to her friends, she seeks out 'kindred spirits' wherever she goes. Though prone to dramatic outbursts of despair over minor mishaps, she maintains an earnest desire to excel in her studies and be good.

_Sources: [v1 c7 P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c20 P31](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0031), [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c27 P11](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0011), [v1 c27 P18](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0018), [v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006)_

## History

Orphaned in infancy in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, Anne Shirley spent her early childhood in the care of guardians before being brought to Prince Edward Island to live with Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert at Green Gables. Though taken in by mistake instead of a boy, she quickly won over her guardians and settled into Avonlea. She attended local school, where she formed a close bond with Diana Barry and established a intense academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe after he called her 'Carrots.' Throughout her school years, she repeatedly found herself in dramatic scrapes, such as accidentally dying her hair green and baking a cake with wrong ingredients. She won the Avery Scholarship at Queen's Academy, but chose to stay at Green Gables and teach locally to support Marilla. Later, she co-founded the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and helped reunite her friend Miss Lavendar with Stephen Irving. Eventually, Anne left Avonlea to pursue her Arts degree at Redmond College in Kingsport, where she excelled in English and began publishing her writings. During her college years, she rejected marriage proposals from Billy Andrews and Gilbert Blythe, and entered into a romantic courtship with Royal Gardner while remaining deeply attached to her Island home.

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to high school teacher Walter Shirley and Bertha Shirley  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned as a baby when both parents died of fever  <sub>[v3 c21 P7](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0007)</sub>
- Taken in by the Thomas family before being adopted by Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c6 P14](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0014), [v3 c3 P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007), [v3 c21 P7](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0007)</sub>
